_meta.description: Offline known-vulnerability DB for component/version correlation (FR-VUL-1). Updatable independently of releases (NFR-USE-2).
_meta.schema: component -> [ {cve, severity, summary, version_lt?, version_ge?, versions?[] } ] (version_lt/version_ge combine as an AND range; versions is an exact-match allowlist and ignores the other two)

linux_kernel.summary: Dirty COW: race condition in copy-on-write handling allows local privilege escalation (write to read-only mappings)
